topics.description: The DHS funding freeze has become the longest partial government shutdown in US history, with concerns about the impact on various programs and services. The shutdown has also led to a freeze in funding for various investigations and programs, including those related to fraud and abuse.

There has been an increase in fraud investigations across various agencies, including the FBI and DHS. These investigations have led to the discovery of millions of dollars in fraudulent activities, with many more cases still being investigated.
